'''September 2000 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA on 24 September 2000. [[Steven Yeager]] won it. It is known from Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1269">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-virginia-beach-va-9-24-00d1269/ virginia-beach-va-9-24-00], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-virginia-beach-va-9-24-00d1269/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 September 2000
* '''Site:''' The Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Steven Yeager]]
